product_one_liner.value: RedTeam provides cloud-based construction management software for commercial general contractors to manage bidding, budgets, project workflows, field collaboration and documents from preconstruction through closeout.

employee_band.notes: Based on the reported employee count of 98; headcount estimates vary by source.

eng_blog.notes: The public Builder Blog covers construction practices and product/marketing topics, not engineer-authored accounts of how the software is built.

public_docs.notes: Public TeamPlayer help center includes multiple article collections; its Basics collection contains seven articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Current hiring status could not be determined: the accessible recruiting material and live Revenue Operations Manager posting do not establish a complete current vacancy list.

model_provider.value: Amazon Web Services — Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Textract
model_provider.notes: The implementation partner’s RedTeam case study publicly identifies these AI services; it does not disclose the underlying foundation model.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed legal pages do not name any of the five requested certifications; this is not a claim that RedTeam lacks them.

last_funding.notes: The funding database identifies February 2, 2022 as the latest round; the company also announced a supporting recapitalization in March 2022.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest reported round predates the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

launched_6mo.notes: August 19, 2026: announced a new submittals experience, including specification-book extraction, configurable review workflows and action ownership tracking.
